description: Land Acquisition - Kapuduuwa, Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District - Walakanda, Kirinda, Puhulwella D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The document focuses exclusively on the process of taking possession of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the core land acquisition content rather than being about government personnel or structural changes.
